en: Explain why the basis period matters for compliance, tax estimation and tax liability
Determine the basis period of a company that has just commenced operations
Apply the CP204 rules: estimates, 85% minimum, instalments, revisions and the 10% penalty
Determine basis periods when a company changes its accounting date
State the notification rules (CP204B) for a change of accounting period
ms: Terangkan kepentingan tempoh asas untuk pematuhan, anggaran cukai dan liabiliti cukai
Tentukan tempoh asas syarikat yang baru memulakan operasi
Gunakan peraturan CP204: anggaran, minimum 85%, ansuran, semakan semula dan penalti 10%
Tentukan tempoh asas apabila syarikat menukar tarikh perakaunan
Nyatakan peraturan pemberitahuan (CP204B) bagi pertukaran tempoh perakaunan

blocks.en: The basis period is the period whose income is taxed in a given Year of Assessment (YA). Getting it right affects three areas of tax management.
blocks.ms: Tempoh asas ialah tempoh yang pendapatannya dicukai dalam sesuatu Tahun Taksiran (YA). Ketepatannya memberi kesan kepada tiga bidang pengurusan cukai.

en: Identifies reporting duties, deadlines and accuracy for each YA
ms: Mengenal pasti kewajipan pelaporan, tarikh akhir dan ketepatan bagi setiap YA

en: Gives the basis for estimating tax chargeable
ms: Menjadi asas untuk menganggar cukai yang dikenakan

en: Fixes adjusted income, the correct capital allowance claim, chargeable income and tax for the YA
ms: Menentukan pendapatan diselaraskan, tuntutan elaun modal yang betul, pendapatan bercukai dan cukai bagi YA

blocks.en: Slide 3 has no readable text (a figure). Slide 4 content is read from the extracted text and may lose its original layout.
blocks.ms: Slaid 3 tiada teks yang boleh dibaca (rajah). Kandungan slaid 4 dibaca daripada teks yang diekstrak dan susun atur asal mungkin hilang.

blocks.en: Commencement is the date the core or integral activity of the business begins [s21A(8)].
blocks.ms: Permulaan ialah tarikh aktiviti teras atau penting perniagaan bermula [s21A(8)].

en: Plant and machinery are in place and inventory (stock) has arrived
ms: Loji dan jentera sedia dan inventori (stok) telah tiba

en: The business is first open to the public with its goods
ms: Perniagaan mula dibuka kepada orang awam dengan barangannya

en: It can offer food, beverage and accommodation to the public
ms: Ia boleh menawarkan makanan, minuman dan penginapan kepada orang awam

en: Shares bought, money deposited to earn interest, loans made for interest, or investment property acquired
ms: Saham dibeli, wang didepositkan untuk faedah, pinjaman diberi untuk faedah, atau hartanah pelaburan diperoleh

blocks.en: Four situations covered
blocks.ms: Empat situasi yang dibincangkan

en: Basis period on commencement of operation [s21A(4)]
An entity in operation that changes its accounting period
A company with existing operations that starts a new operation
A company that joins a partnership
ms: Entiti beroperasi yang menukar tempoh perakaunan
Syarikat sedia ada yang memulakan operasi baharu

title.en: Basis Period for the First Accounts

blocks.en: Look at the calendar year in which the first accounts end (a company’s YA follows the calendar year). My reading of slide 7:
blocks.ms: Lihat tahun kalendar akaun pertama berakhir (YA syarikat mengikut tahun kalendar). Bacaan saya bagi slaid 7:

en: The same year as commencement (under 12 months)
That YA’s basis period is the whole period from commencement to the account date
ms: Tahun yang sama dengan permulaan (kurang 12 bulan)
Tempoh asas YA itu ialah seluruh tempoh dari permulaan hingga tarikh akaun

en: No basis period for the first YA; the second YA takes the whole first accounting period
ms: Tiada tempoh asas bagi YA pertama; YA kedua mengambil seluruh tempoh perakaunan pertama

en: No basis period for the first and second YAs; the third YA takes the whole period
ms: Tiada tempoh asas bagi YA pertama dan kedua; YA ketiga mengambil seluruh tempoh

blocks.en: Worked examples from the slides
blocks.ms: Contoh kerja daripada slaid

blocks.en: Slide 7 is loosely worded, but PR 8/2014 para 4.1 states the same rule: under 12 months ending in the same year = that period; any period ending in the second year = basis period for the second year (none for the first); more than 12 months ending in the third year = basis period for the third year (none for the first two). Applies from YA2014. Lecturer’s exercise 2 (FunTastic: commenced 1.4.2022, first accounts to 30.6.2023) therefore gives no basis period for YA2022 and YA2023 = 1.4.22–30.6.23.
blocks.ms: Slaid 7 berbahasa longgar, tetapi PR 8/2014 para 4.1 menyatakan peraturan yang sama: kurang 12 bulan berakhir dalam tahun sama = tempoh itu; mana-mana tempoh berakhir dalam tahun kedua = tempoh asas tahun kedua (tiada untuk tahun pertama); lebih 12 bulan berakhir dalam tahun ketiga = tempoh asas tahun ketiga (tiada untuk dua tahun pertama). Terpakai dari YA2014. Latihan 2 pensyarah (FunTastic: mula 1.4.2022, akaun pertama hingga 30.6.2023) jadi tiada tempoh asas YA2022 dan YA2023 = 1.4.22–30.6.23.

blocks.en: When to submit the first estimate
blocks.ms: Bila menghantar anggaran pertama

en: New company, basis period more than 6 months
Submit e-CP204 within 3 months of commencing operations [s107C(4)(a)]
ms: Syarikat baru, tempoh asas lebih 6 bulan
Hantar e-CP204 dalam 3 bulan selepas operasi bermula [s107C(4)(a)]

en: New company, basis period less than 6 months
Exempt from furnishing an estimate for that YA
ms: Syarikat baru, tempoh asas kurang 6 bulan
Dikecualikan daripada mengemukakan anggaran bagi YA itu

en: Resident Malaysian company with paid-up ordinary share capital of RM2.5m or less, first commencing operations
Exempt from CP204 for that YA and the next YA (the next two YAs if there is no basis period for the first YA) [s107C(4A)]
ms: Syarikat residen Malaysia dengan modal saham biasa berbayar RM2.5j atau kurang, baru memulakan operasi
Dikecualikan CP204 bagi YA itu dan YA berikutnya (dua YA berikutnya jika tiada tempoh asas bagi YA pertama) [s107C(4A)]

en: Submit no later than 30 days before the start of the basis period [s107C(2)]
ms: Hantar selewat-lewatnya 30 hari sebelum permulaan tempoh asas [s107C(2)]

blocks.en: Slide 12 separates the exemption and the RM2.5m headings; the rows above follow PR 4/2025 para 4.2.2(c). The exemption is lost if more than 50% of the company’s shares are owned by a related company (or vice versa, or both owned by another company), or, from YA2024, if more than 20% of its paid-up capital is owned by companies incorporated outside Malaysia or non-citizen individuals (PR 4/2025 Examples 5–6, Delight Sdn Bhd).
blocks.ms: Slaid 12 memisahkan pengecualian dan tajuk RM2.5j; baris di atas mengikut PR 4/2025 para 4.2.2(c). Pengecualian hilang jika lebih 50% saham syarikat dimiliki syarikat berkaitan (atau sebaliknya, atau kedua-duanya dimiliki syarikat lain), atau, dari YA2024, jika lebih 20% modal berbayar dimiliki syarikat diperbadankan di luar Malaysia atau individu bukan warganegara (PR 4/2025 Contoh 5–6, Delight Sdn Bhd).

blocks.en: Minimum estimate
blocks.ms: Anggaran minimum

en: Year 1: a new entity estimates from projected profits; that estimate is the base for the next YA
Year 2 onwards: at least 85% of the revised estimate (or the original estimate if never revised) for the immediately preceding YA [s107C(3)]
ms: Tahun 1: entiti baru menganggar daripada unjuran keuntungan; anggaran itu menjadi asas YA berikutnya
Tahun ke-2 dan seterusnya: sekurang-kurangnya 85% daripada anggaran disemak (atau anggaran asal jika tidak pernah disemak) bagi YA sebelumnya [s107C(3)]

blocks.en: PR 4/2025 Example 1: estimate RM80,000 for YA2024, revised to RM200,000 in the 6th month. The YA2025 estimate must be at least 85% × RM200,000 = RM170,000.
blocks.ms: PR 4/2025 Contoh 1: anggaran RM80,000 bagi YA2024, disemak kepada RM200,000 pada bulan ke-6. Anggaran YA2025 mesti sekurang-kurangnya 85% × RM200,000 = RM170,000.

blocks.en: Instalments
blocks.ms: Ansuran

en: Equal monthly instalments, each due on the 15th day of the calendar month [s107C(12)]
Already-operating entities start from the 2nd month of the basis period; newly established ones start from the 6th month
ms: Ansuran bulanan sama, setiap satu perlu dibayar pada hari ke-15 bulan kalendar [s107C(12)]
Entiti yang sudah beroperasi bermula dari bulan ke-2 tempoh asas; yang baru ditubuhkan bermula dari bulan ke-6

blocks.en: PR 4/2025 examples. Existing: Dedaun Lebar (BP 1.7.2024–30.6.2025) files CP204 by 31.5.2024 and pays 12 instalments from August 2024 to July 2025, each by the 15th. New: Co-operative Beribu Bintang commenced 1.4.2025, 9-month first period to 31.12.2025, files CP204 by 30.6.2025 and pays 9 instalments from September 2025 to May 2026. A new entity with a basis period under 6 months (Citra Maju LLP, 5 months) need not file.
blocks.ms: Contoh PR 4/2025. Sedia ada: Dedaun Lebar (BP 1.7.2024–30.6.2025) failkan CP204 menjelang 31.5.2024 dan bayar 12 ansuran dari Ogos 2024 hingga Julai 2025, masing-masing pada hari ke-15. Baru: Koperasi Beribu Bintang mula 1.4.2025, tempoh pertama 9 bulan hingga 31.12.2025, failkan CP204 menjelang 30.6.2025 dan bayar 9 ansuran dari September 2025 hingga Mei 2026. Entiti baru dengan tempoh asas kurang 6 bulan (Citra Maju LLP, 5 bulan) tidak perlu memfailkan.

blocks.en: Revising the estimate (e-CP204A) [s107C(7)]
blocks.ms: Menyemak semula anggaran (e-CP204A) [s107C(7)]

blocks.en: Penalty for an under-estimate
blocks.ms: Penalti kerana anggaran kurang

blocks.en: If actual tax payable (AT) exceeds the estimate (ET) by more than 30% of AT, a 10% increase applies to the excess.
blocks.ms: Jika cukai sebenar (AT) melebihi anggaran (ET) lebih 30% daripada AT, kenaan 10% dikenakan ke atas lebihan itu.

en: Unpaid instalments: a 10% increase on each instalment not paid by its due date [s107C(9)], without further notice (PR 4/2025 para 7.1)
If the DGIR issues CP205 (e.g. CP204 not filed), the amount directed is treated as the revised estimate for the 30% test [s107C(8), (10)]
ET in the formula is the latest revised (or deemed revised) estimate, or the original estimate if none
ms: Ansuran tidak dibayar: kenaan 10% atas setiap ansuran yang tidak dibayar pada tarikh akhir [s107C(9)], tanpa notis lanjut (PR 4/2025 para 7.1)
Jika KPHDN mengeluarkan CP205 (cth. CP204 tidak difailkan), amaun yang diarahkan dianggap anggaran disemak bagi ujian 30% [s107C(8), (10)]
ET dalam formula ialah anggaran disemak (atau dianggap disemak) terkini, atau anggaran asal jika tiada

blocks.en: Lecturer’s exercise 4: ET (revised) RM600,000, AT RM890,000. Difference 290,000; 30% × 890,000 = 267,000; excess 23,000; penalty = 10% × 23,000 = RM2,300, so the amount due is RM890,000 + RM2,300.
blocks.ms: Latihan 4 pensyarah: ET (disemak) RM600,000, AT RM890,000. Beza 290,000; 30% × 890,000 = 267,000; lebihan 23,000; penalti = 10% × 23,000 = RM2,300, jadi amaun perlu dibayar RM890,000 + RM2,300.

blocks.en: The first year a company fails to close its accounts on the normal date is the ‘failure year’. The Director General (DG) sets the basis periods for the failure year and the year after, under two rules: (a) no YA is missing; (b) no two accounts close in the same YA.
blocks.ms: Tahun pertama syarikat gagal menutup akaun pada tarikh biasa ialah ‘tahun kegagalan’. Ketua Pengarah (DG) menetapkan tempoh asas bagi tahun kegagalan dan tahun selepasnya, di bawah dua peraturan: (a) tiada YA tertinggal; (b) tiada dua akaun ditutup dalam YA yang sama.

en: Under 12 months, ends in the same year
Combine accounts for the entire period
ms: Kurang 12 bulan, berakhir dalam tahun sama

en: Under 12 months, ends in the following year
Accept the accounting period of the failure year
More than 12 months, ends in the following year
Accept the accounting period of the failure year
More than 12 months, ends in the third year
Divide the accounting period into two periods
Koperasi Rania Emas (normal 31 Dec → 31 Jan, 13 months): YA2024 = 1.1.24–31.7.24 (7 months); YA2025 = 1.8.24–31.1.25 (6 months); YA2026 = 1.2.25–31.1.26
ms: Bahagikan tempoh perakaunan kepada dua tempoh

blocks.en: PR 8/2014 para 5.2 says the DGIR generally accepts the failure-year accounting period provided (a) no YA is missing and (b) no two accounts close in the same YA; it applies whatever the normal year-end. For the ‘two-year’ split (PR 8/2014 Example 9) the period is divided into two; when the division is uneven, any fraction of a month falls in the first basis period (13 months → 7 + 6). The ‘third year’ count starts from the last normal year (2013 normal, 2014 failure year, closes January 2015).
blocks.ms: PR 8/2014 para 5.2 menyatakan KPHDN lazimnya menerima tempoh perakaunan tahun kegagalan dengan syarat (a) tiada YA tertinggal dan (b) tiada dua akaun ditutup dalam YA yang sama; terpakai walau apa pun akhir tahun biasa. Bagi pembahagian ‘dua tahun’ (PR 8/2014 Contoh 9) tempoh dibahagi dua; jika pembahagian tidak sama, sebarang pecahan bulan jatuh dalam tempoh asas pertama (13 bulan → 7 + 6). Kiraan ‘tahun ketiga’ bermula dari tahun biasa terakhir (2013 biasa, 2014 tahun kegagalan, tutup Januari 2015).

blocks.en: Exercise 5 (BRP, normally 31 Dec, changes to 31 March 2025): last normal year 2023; the 15-month period 1.1.2024–31.3.2025 spans two YAs, so it is divided into two with the half-month in the first: YA2024 = 1.1.24–31.8.24 (8 months); YA2025 = 1.9.24–31.3.25 (7 months); YA2026 = 1.4.25–31.3.26. The same ‘divide into two’ rule as Koperasi Rania Emas; my application of the PR.
blocks.ms: Latihan 5 (BRP, biasa 31 Dis, tukar ke 31 Mac 2025): tahun biasa terakhir 2023; tempoh 15 bulan 1.1.2024–31.3.2025 merentasi dua YA, jadi dibahagi dua dengan separuh bulan dalam tempoh pertama: YA2024 = 1.1.24–31.8.24 (8 bulan); YA2025 = 1.9.24–31.3.25 (7 bulan); YA2026 = 1.4.25–31.3.26. Peraturan ‘bahagi dua’ sama seperti Koperasi Rania Emas; aplikasi saya terhadap PR.

blocks.en: Lecturer’s exercise 1 (Teraju Dagang): commenced 1.4.2022, first accounts to 30.6.2023, then 1.7.2023–31.3.2024 (9 months, a change to 31 March; the exercise misprints the year). Applying the ‘under 12 months, following year’ rule: YA2022 none; YA2023 = 1.4.22–30.6.23; YA2024 = 1.7.23–31.3.24; YA2025 = 1.4.24–31.3.25; YA2026 = 1.4.25–31.3.26. My application, not an official answer key.
blocks.ms: Latihan 1 pensyarah (Teraju Dagang): mula 1.4.2022, akaun pertama hingga 30.6.2023, kemudian 1.7.2023–31.3.2024 (9 bulan, pertukaran ke 31 Mac; latihan tersalah cetak tahun). Dengan peraturan ‘kurang 12 bulan, tahun berikutnya’: YA2022 tiada; YA2023 = 1.4.22–30.6.23; YA2024 = 1.7.23–31.3.24; YA2025 = 1.4.24–31.3.25; YA2026 = 1.4.25–31.3.26. Aplikasi saya, bukan kunci jawapan rasmi.

en: The company must notify the IRBM of the change using Form CP204B
Under s107C(8) the DGIR may issue a Notice of Instalment Payments (CP205) if Form CP204 was not furnished on time, or a change of accounting period is notified via CP204B
ms: Syarikat mesti memaklumkan LHDN tentang perubahan menggunakan Borang CP204B
Di bawah s107C(8) KPHDN boleh mengeluarkan Notis Bayaran Ansuran (CP205) jika Borang CP204 tidak dikemukakan tepat pada masanya, atau pertukaran tempoh perakaunan dimaklumkan melalui CP204B

en: Accounting period shortened (under 12 months and new accounts close before the end of the original period)
30 days before the end of the new accounting period
ms: Tempoh perakaunan dipendekkan (kurang 12 bulan dan akaun baru ditutup sebelum tamat tempoh asal)
30 hari sebelum akhir tempoh perakaunan baru

en: Accounting period extended (over 12 months and new accounts close after the end of the original period)
30 days before the end of the original accounting period
ms: Tempoh perakaunan dilanjutkan (lebih 12 bulan dan akaun baru ditutup selepas tamat tempoh asal)
30 hari sebelum akhir tempoh perakaunan asal

blocks.en: Failure to furnish CP204B (from YA2019, PR 4/2025 para 8)
blocks.ms: Gagal mengemukakan CP204B (dari YA2019, PR 4/2025 para 8)

en: 10% increase on the amount by which actual tax exceeds the estimate by more than 30% [s107C(10)]
Penalty under s112(3) on an estimated assessment under s90(3) [s112(3A)]
Prosecution under s120(1)(i): fine of RM200 to RM20,000, or up to 6 months’ imprisonment, or both
ms: Kenaan 10% ke atas amaun cukai sebenar melebihi anggaran lebih 30% [s107C(10)]
Penalti di bawah s112(3) atas taksiran anggaran di bawah s90(3) [s112(3A)]
Pendakwaan di bawah s120(1)(i): denda RM200 hingga RM20,000, atau penjara sehingga 6 bulan, atau kedua-duanya

blocks.en: Company under liquidation (PR 7/2016)
blocks.ms: Syarikat dalam pembubaran (PR 7/2016)

en: Basis period follows s21A(3) and the principles of PR 8/2014; from YA2014 the DGIR fixes the basis periods for the failure year and the next YA

Generally the company’s own accounting period in the failure year is accepted if: no YA is missing; two accounts are not closed in the same YA as the basis period; and the first accounts closed in the failure year are the basis period for that YA or are combined with the next accounts
A liquidator prepares accounts for 6 months from the date of appointment and then every 6 months
ms: Tempoh asas mengikut s21A(3) dan prinsip PR 8/2014; dari YA2014 KPHDN menetapkan tempoh asas bagi tahun kegagalan dan YA berikutnya

Secara amnya tempoh perakaunan syarikat sendiri pada tahun kegagalan diterima jika: tiada YA tertinggal; dua akaun tidak ditutup dalam YA sama sebagai tempoh asas; dan akaun pertama ditutup pada tahun kegagalan ialah tempoh asas YA itu atau digabung dengan akaun seterusnya
Pelikuidasi menyediakan akaun bagi 6 bulan dari tarikh pelantikan dan kemudian setiap 6 bulan

blocks.en: New operation or partnership
blocks.ms: Operasi baharu atau perkongsian

en: A company with existing operations that starts a new operation: the new operation’s basis period equals that of the existing operation (PR 8/2014 Ex 10: year-end 30 Sept, new operation from 1.6.2014 → YA2014 basis period 1.6.2014–30.9.2014)

A company that joins a partnership: the partnership is a new operation, so the company’s basis period for it equals that of its existing operations, regardless of the partnership’s own year-end (Ex 11: company year-end 30 June, partnership from 18.2.2014 → YA2014 = 18.2.2014–30.6.2014)
ms: Syarikat sedia ada yang memulakan operasi baharu: tempoh asas operasi baharu sama dengan operasi sedia ada (PR 8/2014 Cth 10: akhir tahun 30 Sept, operasi baharu dari 1.6.2014 → tempoh asas YA2014 1.6.2014–30.9.2014)

Syarikat yang menyertai perkongsian: perkongsian ialah operasi baharu, jadi tempoh asas syarikat bagi perkongsian sama dengan operasi sedia ada, tanpa mengira akhir tahun perkongsian (Cth 11: akhir tahun syarikat 30 Jun, perkongsian dari 18.2.2014 → YA2014 = 18.2.2014–30.6.2014)

blocks.en: The lecturer’s file Exercise_basis period.pdf has questions only, with no answers. The answers below are worked out from the slides and PR 8/2014, PR 4/2025 and PR 7/2016, so treat them as my application of the rules, not an official key.
blocks.ms: Fail pensyarah Exercise_basis period.pdf hanya ada soalan, tiada jawapan. Jawapan di bawah dikira daripada slaid serta PR 8/2014, PR 4/2025 dan PR 7/2016, jadi anggap ia aplikasi saya terhadap peraturan, bukan kunci rasmi.

blocks.en: Exercise 1: Teraju Dagang Sdn Bhd
blocks.ms: Latihan 1: Teraju Dagang Sdn Bhd

blocks.en: Commenced 1.4.2022; first accounts to 30.6.2023 and then each 30 June. On 1.9.2023 it changed its year end to 31 March. Accounts: 1.7.2023–31.3.2024, 1.4.2024–31.3.2025, 1.4.2025–31.3.2026. State the basis period for each YA up to YA2026.
blocks.ms: Mula 1.4.2022; akaun pertama hingga 30.6.2023 dan kemudian setiap 30 Jun. Pada 1.9.2023 ia menukar akhir tahun ke 31 Mac. Akaun: 1.7.2023–31.3.2024, 1.4.2024–31.3.2025, 1.4.2025–31.3.2026. Nyatakan tempoh asas setiap YA hingga YA2026.

en: First accounts (15 months) end in 2023, the second year
ms: Akaun pertama (15 bulan) berakhir pada 2023, tahun kedua

en: The whole first period is the basis period for the second year (PR 8/2014 para 4.1)
ms: Seluruh tempoh pertama ialah tempoh asas tahun kedua (PR 8/2014 para 4.1)

en: 9-month accounts, the only accounts closing in 2024; no YA is missing
ms: Akaun 9 bulan, satu-satunya akaun ditutup pada 2024; tiada YA tertinggal

blocks.en: The question says the company changed to ‘31 March 2023’, but the accounts listed end 31 March 2024, so I treated 2023 as a misprint of 2024.
blocks.ms: Soalan menyebut ‘31 Mac 2023’ tetapi akaun disenaraikan berakhir 31 Mac 2024, jadi saya anggap 2023 sebagai salah cetak bagi 2024.

blocks.en: Exercise 2: FunTastic Sdn Bhd
blocks.ms: Latihan 2: FunTastic Sdn Bhd

blocks.en: Commenced 1.4.2022; first accounts to 30.6.2023, then each 30 June.
blocks.ms: Mula 1.4.2022; akaun pertama hingga 30.6.2023, kemudian setiap 30 Jun.

en: The first accounts are 15 months and end in the second year, so YA2022 has no basis period (PR 8/2014)
ms: Akaun pertama 15 bulan dan berakhir pada tahun kedua, jadi YA2022 tiada tempoh asas (PR 8/2014)

en: New company with a basis period over 6 months: within 3 months of commencing operations [s107C(4)(a)]. 1.4.2022 + 3 months
ms: Syarikat baru dengan tempoh asas melebihi 6 bulan: dalam 3 bulan selepas operasi bermula [s107C(4)(a)]. 1.4.2022 + 3 bulan

en: New entity: instalments start in the 6th month of the basis period (1.4.2022 → September 2022), due on the 15th
ms: Entiti baru: ansuran bermula pada bulan ke-6 tempoh asas (1.4.2022 → September 2022), perlu dibayar pada hari ke-15

en: YA2022: no return (no basis period). YA2023: 31 January 2024. YA2024: 31 January 2025
Return due 7 months after the end of the basis period: 30.6.2023 + 7 months; 30.6.2024 + 7 months
ms: YA2022: tiada borang (tiada tempoh asas). YA2023: 31 Januari 2024. YA2024: 31 Januari 2025
Borang nyata perlu 7 bulan selepas akhir tempoh asas: 30.6.2023 + 7 bulan; 30.6.2024 + 7 bulan

blocks.en: Part (ii) and (iii) are asked ‘for YA2022’ but YA2022 has no basis period, so the estimate really covers the 15-month first basis period. The deadlines are counted from the date operations commenced. A resident company with paid-up capital of RM2.5m or less may be exempt from CP204 for its first YAs [s107C(4A)] if the conditions are met.
blocks.ms: Bahagian (ii) dan (iii) ditanya ‘bagi YA2022’ tetapi YA2022 tiada tempoh asas, jadi anggaran sebenarnya meliputi tempoh asas pertama 15 bulan. Tarikh akhir dikira dari tarikh operasi bermula. Syarikat residen dengan modal berbayar RM2.5j atau kurang mungkin dikecualikan CP204 bagi YA awal [s107C(4A)] jika syarat dipenuhi.

blocks.en: Original estimate RM880,000, revised to RM600,000 in the 6th month with IRB approval. Actual tax payable RM890,000.
blocks.ms: Anggaran asal RM880,000, disemak kepada RM600,000 pada bulan ke-6 dengan kelulusan LHDN. Cukai sebenar RM890,000.

(i) Beza = 890,000 − 600,000 = RM290,000
Had selamat = 30% × 890,000 = RM267,000
Lebihan = 290,000 − 267,000 = RM23,000
Penalti = 10% × 23,000 = RM2,300
Jumlah perlu dibayar = RM890,000 + RM2,300 = RM892,300, iaitu RM292,300 selepas ansuran RM600,000

blocks.en: The test uses the latest revised estimate (RM600,000), not the original RM880,000.
blocks.ms: Ujian menggunakan anggaran disemak terkini (RM600,000), bukan RM880,000 asal.

blocks.en:
(ii) If the RM290,000 balance of tax is not settled in time, a further 10% late-payment penalty applies: 10% × 290,000 = RM29,000
Total = 290,000 + 2,300 + 29,000 = RM321,300
blocks.ms:
(ii) Jika baki cukai RM290,000 tidak dijelaskan tepat masa, penalti lewat bayar 10% tambahan dikenakan: 10% × 290,000 = RM29,000
Jumlah = 290,000 + 2,300 + 29,000 = RM321,300

blocks.en: Part (ii) is my reading: the 10% late-payment penalty is applied to the unpaid balance of tax (RM290,000). The lecturer has not given a key, so check how your class applies it to the RM2,300.
blocks.ms: Bahagian (ii) ialah bacaan saya: penalti lewat bayar 10% dikenakan atas baki cukai tidak dibayar (RM290,000). Pensyarah tidak memberi kunci, jadi semak bagaimana kelas anda mengenakannya pada RM2,300.

blocks.en: (a) Sugeh Sdn Bhd: when does trading commence?
blocks.ms: (a) Sugeh Sdn Bhd: bilakah perdagangan bermula?

blocks.en:
Question
Sugeh Sdn Bhd (SSB), a newly formed Malaysian tax resident company, closes accounts annually on 31 December. SSB acquired a piece of land to construct a factory building for the manufacture of refrigeration products. Relevant details are provided below:
18 February 2023: Date of incorporation
26 May 2023: Land acquired
11 August 2023: Agreement signed for construction of factory building
24 October 2024: Construction of factory building was completed and ready for use
1 December 2024: First batch of raw materials received
12 January 2025: First sale of products

Required: Explain when Sugeh Sdn Bhd will be regarded as having commenced trading.
blocks.ms:
Soalan
Sugeh Sdn Bhd (SSB), a newly formed Malaysian tax resident company, closes accounts annually on 31 December. SSB acquired a piece of land to construct a factory building for the manufacture of refrigeration products. Relevant details are provided below:
18 February 2023: Date of incorporation
26 May 2023: Land acquired
11 August 2023: Agreement signed for construction of factory building
24 October 2024: Construction of factory building was completed and ready for use
1 December 2024: First batch of raw materials received
12 January 2025: First sale of products

Required: Explain when Sugeh Sdn Bhd will be regarded as having commenced trading.

en: Preparatory: the business has not yet begun its income-producing activity
ms: Persediaan: perniagaan belum memulakan aktiviti menjana pendapatan

en: Purchase of raw materials is the first act in the income-producing process of a manufacturer (PR 11/2013 para 5.2(a))
ms: Pembelian bahan mentah ialah tindakan pertama dalam proses menjana pendapatan pengeluar (PR 11/2013 para 5.2(a))

en: Sales are the result of trading, not its start
ms: Jualan ialah hasil perdagangan, bukan permulaan

blocks.en: Answer: SSB is regarded as having commenced trading on 1 December 2024. Commencement is the start of activities in the course of business, as distinct from preparatory activities (PR 11/2013 para 5.2); for manufacturing, the purchase of raw materials is the indicator. Consequences: the first basis period is 1.12.2024–31.12.2024 (under 12 months, same year), so YA2024 = 1.12.2024–31.12.2024 and YA2025 = 1.1.2025–31.12.2025; revenue expenses incurred before 1.12.2024 that qualify are deemed incurred on that day.
blocks.ms: Jawapan: SSB dianggap memulakan perdagangan pada 1 Disember 2024. Permulaan ialah mula aktiviti dalam perjalanan perniagaan, berbeza daripada aktiviti persediaan (PR 11/2013 para 5.2); bagi pembuatan, pembelian bahan mentah ialah petunjuknya. Akibatnya: tempoh asas pertama 1.12.2024–31.12.2024 (kurang 12 bulan, tahun sama), jadi YA2024 = 1.12.2024–31.12.2024 dan YA2025 = 1.1.2025–31.12.2025; perbelanjaan hasil sebelum 1.12.2024 yang layak dianggap ditanggung pada hari itu.

blocks.en: Your slide 7 (Chapter 1) says manufacturing starts when plant and machinery are in place and stock has arrived. Both give 1.12.2024 here, if the machinery was already installed.
blocks.ms: Slaid 7 anda (Bab 1) menyatakan pembuatan bermula apabila loji dan jentera sedia dan stok tiba. Kedua-duanya memberi 1.12.2024 di sini, jika jentera sudah dipasang.

blocks.en: (b) Lazat Sdn Bhd: basis periods
blocks.ms: (b) Lazat Sdn Bhd: tempoh asas

blocks.en:
Question
Lazat Sdn. Bhd. commenced business on 1 July 2020 and prepare its first set of accounts to 31 March 2021. The company decided to change its accounting period to end on 31 December annually. Later, after the appointment of the new Chairman and Board of Directors in 2024, the company again change its accounting period to 31 October annually. The following information pertaining to the accounting periods:
Year of assessment 2021: 1/7/2020 – 31/3/2021
Year of assessment 2022: 1/4/2021 – 31/3/2022
Year of assessment 2022: 1/4/2022 – 31/12/2022
Year of assessment 2023: 1/1/2023 – 31/12/2023
Year of assessment 2025: 1/1/2024 – 31/10/2025

Required: Determine the basis period for all the relevant years of assessment until year of assessment 2025.
blocks.ms:
Soalan
Lazat Sdn. Bhd. commenced business on 1 July 2020 and prepare its first set of accounts to 31 March 2021. The company decided to change its accounting period to end on 31 December annually. Later, after the appointment of the new Chairman and Board of Directors in 2024, the company again change its accounting period to 31 October annually. The following information pertaining to the accounting periods:
Year of assessment 2021: 1/7/2020 – 31/3/2021
Year of assessment 2022: 1/4/2021 – 31/3/2022
Year of assessment 2022: 1/4/2022 – 31/12/2022
Year of assessment 2023: 1/1/2023 – 31/12/2023
Year of assessment 2025: 1/1/2024 – 31/10/2025

Required: Determine the basis period for all the relevant years of assessment until year of assessment 2025.

en: First accounts (9 months) end in 2021, the second year; there is no basis period for the first YA (PR 8/2014 para 4.1)
ms: Akaun pertama (9 bulan) berakhir 2021, tahun kedua; tiada tempoh asas bagi YA pertama (PR 8/2014 para 4.1)

en: Two accounts close in YA2022 (31.3.2022 and 31.12.2022). They are combined so that no two accounts close in the same YA
ms: Dua akaun ditutup dalam YA2022 (31.3.2022 dan 31.12.2022). Digabung supaya tiada dua akaun ditutup dalam YA yang sama

en: Normal year to the new date
Failure year (no accounts closed on 31.12.2024). The 22-month period ends in the third year, so it is divided into two equal parts
ms: Tahun kegagalan (tiada akaun ditutup pada 31.12.2024). Tempoh 22 bulan berakhir pada tahun ketiga, jadi dibahagi dua sama rata

blocks.en: The table in the question prints YA2022 twice and has no YA2024; the answer above gives every YA from 2020 to 2025. The split follows PR 8/2014 (the ‘two-year’ division; Example 9) and the same pattern as Koperasi Rania Emas on your slides. A 22-month period divides exactly into 11 + 11, so no half-month arises.
blocks.ms: Jadual dalam soalan mencetak YA2022 dua kali dan tiada YA2024; jawapan di atas memberi setiap YA dari 2020 hingga 2025. Pembahagian ikut PR 8/2014 (pembahagian ‘dua tahun’; Contoh 9) dan corak sama seperti Koperasi Rania Emas dalam slaid anda. Tempoh 22 bulan terbahagi tepat 11 + 11, jadi tiada setengah bulan.

q.en: Describe the four cases of a change in accounting period.

en: Under 12 months: same year / following year (2)

q.en: When and how must a change of accounting period be notified?
q.ms: Bila dan bagaimana pertukaran tempoh perakaunan dimaklumkan?

en: Shortened: 30 days before new period ends (1)
Extended: 30 days before original period ends (1)
ms: Dipendekkan: 30 hari sebelum tempoh baru tamat (1)
